        int min;

        public void check(ArrayList<int[]> aa, int a[], int b[]) {
            for (int i = 0; i < aa.size(); i++) {
                int m = Math.min(a[aa.get(i)[0]], b[aa.get(i)[1]]);
                b[aa.get(i)[1]] -= m;

            }

            aa.add(new int[]{2, 2});
            aa.add(new int[]{0, 2});
            aa.add(new int[]{1, 0});
            aa.add(new int[]{2, 1});
            per(aa, 0, a, b);
            out.println(min + " " + max);
        }

        public StringTokenizer tokenizer;
